answer: Timed physical-presence chalice. Each identity must periodically complete a voyage to a designated karst field station and perform a measured task, such as collecting a water sample from a marked terrace at a stated time. A local witness device signs the sample's chain of custody. Enforcement: identity stays active only while its signed samples arrive within staggered, unpredictable windows. Cost to attacker: one human courier per identity per cycle, plus travel and sample logistics, so N sybils require N physical trips.
